All three sizes are rendered and verified. Final results:

**`square.png` — 1080×1080**
- Logo + divider + "FIELDNOTES CONF 2026" top-left

- 66px title wrapping to 3 lines, accent on "speed of trust"

**`landscape.png` — 1920×1080**
- Two-column layout: title/meta/CTA left, 420px circular portrait with name/role right

**`story.png` — 1080×1920**

- 72px centered title, 4 lines
